notes.title: Cube Course - Revised
notes.notes:
As some may know Cube Course had a bug where the player would move slower if your monitor was <120Hz and faster if your monitor was >120Hz. Cube Course - Revised fixes this.

Cube Course - Revised can be considered it's own game so I have included a launcher allowing you to either play Cube Course - Revised or the original. However the original is not recommended as it contains numerous bugs.

This will be the last update (at least major one) to Cube Course.

notes.title: Cube Course out of Early Access
notes.notes:
I'm excited to say that Cube Course is finished.
I had to rethink some of the goals I had to be more realistic,  specifically the amount of levels.

My goal was to have 100 levels, but I settled for 45. Every single one of these levels are hand-painted by me and consume a great amount of time. As I have to work around my work schedule, 100 levels just didn't seem reasonable anymore.

Thank you for all that supported me and my game. With this release comes version 1.6, which was not big enough for its own announcement. You can view all the change logs in the main menu or on my website. Once Again, Thank you.

notes.title: Cube Course Version 1.5 is here!
notes.notes: Version 1.5 is a small update that offers a setting to toggle the sky, as well as 10 more levels.

notes.title: Cube Course Version 1.4 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1][u]Version 1.4 brings with it:[/u][/h1]
- 10 more levels (Bringing the amount of levels up to 30).
- 4 new blocks/interactions.
- A set FPS, otherwise the game would run faster on computers utilizing a high refresh rate monitor. (No tearing or visual distortion observed).

[i]* Level 29 and up will get slightly more challenging... *[/i]

I will continue to create more blocks and interactions on my way to making 100 levels. 

[u]If any bugs are found, please submit a form on my website.[/u]
